target: Original PVR policy, actually filled first entries only: complete0-to-0 net round PnL>0 including original costs and accrued dividends. Not five-day proxy.
policy: Original PVR account only; do not combine E31 or unfunded candidates.
first_year_training: 2022 actual rounds, only when completely closed before each future model cutoff; no2021 labels exist.
feature_clock: Original signal-day close only. No entry next-open, forward return, eventual holding length/add count/round cost/close time as inputs.
fit_clock: First common trading session monthly; trailing504 common trading days by signal date; closed_day strictly before model date. No label from a round still open at that date.
model: Single logistic NLL sum +2*sum(nonintercept standardized coefficients squared). Training-only mean/std and clip standardized features +/-5. Unpenalized intercept. No class balancing/interactions/tuning.
missing: Any invalid/nonfinite feature => UNKNOWN; no imputation. Retain all original actual first entries, including unclosed rounds and unknown predictions.
baseline: Primary comparator is mean win fraction of exactly the same mature feature-complete training rows. Also report mean of all mature rows in same window as secondary baseline; no future calibration.
quintiles: Fixed Q1-Q5 cutpoints from current model probabilities on current mature training rows, using20/40/60/80 percentiles. Assign future first entries using only these previously known cutpoints; never choose thresholds by outcomes.
cohorts: Report all actually filled originals and separately NORMAL signal context, excluding initial2022-01-04 and original ACT OFF-to-ON decision dates. Do not refit after excluding contexts.
evaluation: Primary2023-2025 entry-year cohorts with labels observed by original source end;2026 partial secondary. Separate closed-by-entry-year, eventually complete by source end and still-open; pending not random missing.
metrics: AUC including same-date AUC with eligible date counts
Brier/logloss versus historical-mean comparator, probability-bin calibration
causal training-score quintile win rates and return/payoff ratios, every bin reported
date-block and stock-cluster uncertainty, coverage and censoring bounds
training maturity/delay profile as descriptive audit only
dependence: 20-common-session blocks and stock clusters; report conservative maximum block/stock/two-way SE for proper-score differences; AUC date-block and stock jackknife as approximate descriptive uncertainty.
label_delay_warning: Closed-only training estimates a completion-conditioned history distribution. Winners/losers may close at different speeds; open labels remain unavailable, no imputation or false independence. This diagnostic cannot identify counterfactual new selections.
restrictions: no candidate filtering or new trades
no assertion30percent achieved by selecting a historical high-score bin
history_limits: Already consumed history, fixed future pool and non-PIT industry/availability/adjustment provenance; temporal forward predictions are reproducible as-of-model outputs, not genuinely untouched out of sample.
label_accounting: Use original complete round PnL: executed trade cash and original dividend entitlement accrued during holding; not future realised price path. Original execution is a causal-open proxy, not certified market fills.
